items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Mo Rambles, who had Mo Rambles, I know who heard of him. Oh yeah. The trumpet player.

ctx.x: So I sold my outfit I had. Yeah. So after I got married and moved down here, I was over across the street at 825. Yeah. Well that was during the days of Mo Rambles, Mo Rambles, who had Mo Rambles, I know who heard of him. Oh yeah. The trumpet player. Well Walter Nelson, he's down here at the Piku's place, he plays steel guitar. Yeah. Him and I had met one night up on Bama Street by some friends of ours and he was playing his guitar and I was passing my foot in tempo with him, you know. He said, Joe, do you ever…
